ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; approximately 98% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity black pixels with minimal high-intensity white pixel coverage limited to focal scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black pigmentation across both lobes; two distinct high-intensity (white) circular ring-like clusters are located on the distal upper quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate 80-degree internal angle and a moderate pixel depth relative to the vertical lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire continuous boundary; peak amplitudes range from 3 to 12 pixels, with the most pronounced peaks located on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curve sweeping upward from the median notch toward the distal tips, forming acute, tapered points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of two white circular ring structures on the upper left lobe, exhibiting high contrast against the dark background pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notches on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, deeper than the surrounding serration frequency.
